es: Resolver una situación real de llegada a una ciudad extranjera: hacer contactos, negociar un alquiler con condiciones y reparar un malentendido.

teaching.en: As a newcomer, I asked my neighbour a follow-up question about the best market.
teaching.es: Como recién llegado, le hice a mi vecino una pregunta de seguimiento sobre el mejor mercado.
teaching.explanationEs: Hacer contactos: retoma lo que dice el otro con una pregunta de seguimiento.
segments: As a newcomer, I asked my neighbour
a follow-up question about the best market.
teaching.audioText: As a newcomer, I asked my neighbour a follow-up question about the best market.

teaching.en: Good morning, I am writing to the landlord about the flat on Elm Street.
teaching.es: Buenos días, le escribo al casero por el piso de la calle Elm.
teaching.explanationEs: Primer contacto con el casero: registro formal y motivo claro en la primera frase.
segments: Good morning, I am writing to the
landlord about the flat on Elm Street.
teaching.audioText: Good morning, I am writing to the landlord about the flat on Elm Street.

teaching.en: I can pay the deposit now, provided that the rent stays at 600 a month.
teaching.es: Puedo pagar la fianza ahora, siempre que el alquiler siga en 600 al mes.
teaching.explanationEs: Provided that + presente simple: condición clara. No se usa will después.
segments: I can pay the deposit now, provided that
the rent stays at 600 a month.
teaching.audioText: I can pay the deposit now, provided that the rent stays at 600 a month.

teaching.en: I will pay three months in advance in exchange for a lower rent.
teaching.es: Pagaré tres meses por adelantado a cambio de un alquiler más bajo.
teaching.explanationEs: In exchange for = a cambio de: propones un trueque, no solo pides.
segments: I will pay three months in advance
in exchange for a lower rent.
teaching.audioText: I will pay three months in advance in exchange for a lower rent.

teaching.en: I think there was a misunderstanding: I meant the second floor, not the first.
teaching.es: Creo que hubo un malentendido: yo quería decir el segundo piso, no el primero.
teaching.explanationEs: There was a misunderstanding reparte la responsabilidad; «you misunderstood» acusa.
segments: I think there was a misunderstanding: I
meant the second floor, not the first.
teaching.audioText: I think there was a misunderstanding: I meant the second floor, not the first.

teaching.en: Let me clarify what I meant, and thank you for your patience.
teaching.es: Déjame aclarar lo que quise decir, y gracias por tu paciencia.
teaching.explanationEs: Clarify + what I meant: aclaras sin culpar. Cierra siempre con un agradecimiento.
segments: Let me clarify what I meant,
and thank you for your patience.
teaching.audioText: Let me clarify what I meant, and thank you for your patience.

prompt.es: ¿Qué pregunta de seguimiento retoma lo que dijo la vecina?

choices.text: Where is the market?
I moved here last week.
What made you leave Seville?

feedback.es: «What made you leave Seville?» retoma el dato que dio la vecina. Las otras dos cambian de tema o repiten lo que dice el hablante.

hint.es: Busca la pregunta que retoma el dato que acaba de dar la vecina.

origin.text: Neighbour: I moved here from Seville two years ago.

prompt.es: Completa: «Puedo pagar ahora, siempre que bajen el alquiler.»

feedback.es: Provided that + presente simple introduce una condición clara en una negociación.

hint.es: Es el participio que introduce una condición y va seguido de that.

origin.text: I can pay now, ___ that you lower the rent.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase repara el malentendido sin culpar al otro?

choices.text: I think there was a misunderstanding: I meant the second floor.
You are wrong, because I never said that.
It is not my fault; you did not listen.

feedback.es: Hablar de «a misunderstanding» y aclarar lo que querías decir repara sin acusar. Las otras dos culpan a la otra persona.

hint.es: Repara sin culpar: no empieces la frase con «tú».

origin.text: Landlord: You said the flat was on the first floor.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Puedo ofrecer una fianza mayor a cambio de un contrato más corto.»

answer.text: I can offer a bigger deposit in exchange for a shorter contract

feedback.es: In exchange for introduce lo que recibes a cambio de tu oferta: a bigger deposit por un shorter contract.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué hace el hablante para mantener viva la conversación.

choices.text: He changes the subject to the weather.
He asks a follow-up question about the bakery.
He talks only about himself.

feedback.es: El hablante retoma lo que dijo el otro (la panadería) con una pregunta de seguimiento, no cambia de tema ni habla solo de sí mismo.

origin.audio: Good evening. I am new in town, so I would love some advice. You said you run a bakery. What made you open it here?

prompt.es: Relaciona cada fórmula con su función en la negociación.

pairs.es: Condición: solo si ocurre lo indicado
Intercambio: doy algo a cambio de otra cosa

feedback.es: Cada fórmula cumple una función distinta: condición, intercambio, aclaración y reparación sin culpar.

pairs.es: Condición: solo si ocurre lo indicado
Intercambio: doy algo a cambio de otra cosa

prompt.es: Escribe al casero: preséntate, negocia con condiciones y repara un malentendido.

answer.text: Dear Mr Reid, Good morning. I am a newcomer to the city, and I am writing about the flat on Elm Street. I can pay the deposit now, provided that the rent is 650 a month instead of 700. In exchange for the lower rent, I would sign a twelve-month contract. I also think there was a misunderstanding about the floor: I meant the second floor, not the first. Let me clarify this now so that we can avoid any problem later. Thank you very much for your patience, and I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Carlos
accepted: Dear Mr Reid, Good morning. I am a newcomer to the city, and I am writing about the flat on Elm Street. I can pay the deposit now, provided that the rent is 650 a month instead of 700. In exchange for the lower rent, I would sign a twelve-month contract. I also think there was a misunderstanding about the floor: I meant the second floor, not the first. Let me clarify this now so that we can avoid any problem later. Thank you very much for your patience, and I look forward to your reply. Kind regards, Carlos

Dear Mr Reid, I have just arrived in the city, so I am new to everything. I am interested in the flat on Elm Street. I would pay the deposit today as long as the rent is 650 a month and not 700. In return, I can offer a twelve-month contract. I believe there was a misunderstanding about the floor, because what I meant was the second floor. I would like to clarify this before we meet. Thank you for your time and your patience. Yours sincerely, Carlos

feedback.es: Un mensaje completo se presenta como recién llegado, ofrece con condición (provided that), propone un intercambio, repara sin culpar y cierra con cortesía.

origin.text: Acabas de llegar a una ciudad nueva. Escribe al casero, el señor Reid: preséntate como recién llegado; ofrece pagar la fianza ahora si el alquiler baja de 700 a 650; ofrece un contrato de doce meses a cambio; repara un malentendido: querías decir el segundo piso, no el primero; cierra con cortesía.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige en qué condiciones se cierra el trato.

choices.text: The bills are included, and the tenant pays no deposit.
The bills are not included, and the tenant signs for six months.
The bills are included, and the tenant signs for a year.

feedback.es: El inquilino pide que se incluyan los gastos y el casero acepta si firma por un año: ese es el trato final.

origin.audio: Tenant: I will take the flat if you add the bills to the rent. Landlord: I can do that, but only if you sign for a year. Tenant: Fine, we have a deal.

prompt.es: ¿Qué corrección arregla el registro y el tacto de este mensaje?

choices.text: Good morning, Mr Reid. Could you give me the keys today? I see the date slightly differently.
Hello. I want the keys. The date is wrong.
Dear Mr Reid, you were wrong about the date.

feedback.es: La versión con saludo formal, petición con Could you y «slightly differently» arregla el registro y el tacto a la vez. Las otras siguen siendo bruscas o acusan.

origin.text: Hi landlord! Give me the keys now. By the way, you are wrong about the date.

prompt.es: Completa tres funciones: contacto, condición y reparación.

feedback.es: «What made you…?» sostiene el contacto, provided that marca la condición y there was a misunderstanding repara sin culpar.

sentences: Nice to meet you! What ___ you move to this city?
I will pay now, ___ that the rent stays the same.
I think there was a ___ about the date.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo repara Ana el malentendido.

choices.text: She blames the landlord for the mistake.
She clarifies what she meant and gives the right day.
She cancels the appointment.

feedback.es: Ana reconoce que dijo otra cosa, aclara lo que quería decir y da el día correcto, sin culpar a nadie.

origin.audio: Sorry, I said Friday, but I meant Thursday. Let me clarify: the keys are ready on Thursday.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta sostiene la conversación con una pregunta de seguimiento?

choices.text: I work in an office.
The hospital is boring.
Nights must be hard. How do you rest during the day?

feedback.es: «Nights must be hard. How do you rest during the day?» retoma el turno de noche y pide más información. Las otras respuestas cortan la conversación.

origin.text: Neighbour: I work at the hospital, mostly at night.

prompt.es: Propón un intercambio: «Pago la fianza ahora a cambio de un contrato de un año.»

answer.text: I will pay the deposit now in exchange for a one-year contract.
accepted: I will pay the deposit now in exchange for a one-year contract.
I can pay the deposit now in exchange for a one-year contract.
I will pay the deposit now in return for a one-year contract.
In exchange for a one-year contract, I will pay the deposit now.

feedback.es: In exchange for (o in return for) presenta lo que recibes a cambio de tu oferta: el contrato de un año.

origin.text: Pago la fianza ahora a cambio de un contrato de un año.
